name: Bodyweight Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back braced across the edge of a flat bench and plant your feet hip-width apart.
Tuck your chin lightly forward and brace your abs.
Drive firmly through your heels to raise your hips until your torso and thighs form a horizontal line with shins vertical.
Squeeze your glutes firmly at the top, then lower your hips smoothly back toward the floor.
tips: Keep your ribs tucked down and finish the lift with your glutes rather than arching your lower back.
Adjust your foot distance so your knees bend near 90 degrees at the top.
